title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: EMERGENCY PARKING BRAKE:MECHANICAL:RELEASE MECHANI (2,400 affected)
summary: THE HANDLE OF THE EMERGENCY BRAKE CONTAINS A TORSION SPRING WHICH IS DESIGNED TO ENSURE THAT THE LOCKING MECHANISM REMAINS FIRMLY ENGAGED UPON APPLICATION OF THE EMERGENCY BRAKE. SOME OF THESE SPRINGS MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY INSTALLED.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (11,432 affected)
summary: THE FUEL FEED HOSE CAN PULL OUT OF THE CRIMPED COUPLING AT THE ENGINE END OF THE HOSE ASSEMBLY, CAUSING FUEL LEAKAGE.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: EQUIPMENT:JACKS (844 affected)
summary: INCORRECT LUBRICANT WAS USED IN THE GEAR BOX OF THE INBOARD STYLE SUPPORT LEG ASSEMBLY AND THE GEAR RATIO OF THE ASSEMBLY RESULTS IN DIMINISHING THE SELF-LOCKING ASPECT OF THE UNIT. THIS CAUSES THE ASSEMBLY TO RETRACT IN AN UNCONTROLLED AND UNEXPECTED MANNER.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:FITTINGS:METALLIC (17,400 affected)
summary: BRAKE LINES IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT ARE ROUTED TOO NEAR THE LEFT EXHAUST MANIFOLD, CAUSING THE BRAKE FLUID TO OVERHEAT.

title: Toyota Motor Corporation: EQUIPMENT:ELECTRIC EQUIPMENT:RADIO:TAPE DECK ETC. (155,809 affected)
summary: FAILURE OF A SPECIFIC ELECTRONIC COMPONENT IN THE RADIOS CAUSES AN ELECTRICAL SHORT CIRCUIT.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV (11,000 affected)
summary: WINDSHIELD FRAME METAL MAY CRACK AT THE WIPER ARM PIVOT MOUNTINGS DUE TO METAL STRESS DURING WIPER OPERATION.

title: Jayco, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (3,143 affected)
summary: THE SWITCH WHICH OPENS THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY OR DAMAGED DURING SHIPPING. ALSO, MOISTURE CAN INTRUDE INTO THE CONTROL MODULE. ANY ONE OF THESE CONDITIONS CAN CAUSE THE SLIDE OUT ROOM TO OPEN WHEN THE SWITCH IS OFF.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM (985 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER ARM SUPPORT CRACKS WHERE THE WIPER ARM PIVOT MOUNTS TO THE SUPPORT BRACKETS CAUSING FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: VISUAL SYSTEMS:WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE:PIVOT:DRIV (505 affected)
summary: CONTACT INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE WINDSHIELD WIPER LINKAGE AND THE MOTOR OUTPUT SHAFT NUT CAUSES LINKAGE SEPARATION, RESULTING IN FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH:NEUTRAL START (1,103 affected)
summary: THE NEUTRAL START SAFETY SWITCH COULD HAVE BEEN FRACTURED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: DORSEY CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (979 affected)
summary: IMPROPER ROUTING OF THE AIR BRAKE HOSES FROM THE BRAKE VALVES TO THE BRAKE CHAMBERS OF THE AIR OPERATED S-CAM BRAKES CAN CAUSE THE HOSES TO CHAFE OR BE CUT ON THE TRAILER FRAME.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL (70,154 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE PEDAL PUSH ROD RETAINER IS MISSING, MISPOSITIONED OR NOT PROPERLY SEATED.

title: BRUNSWICK CORPORATION: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (404 affected)
summary: THE CNG TANKS MAY HAVE BEEN FITTED WITH PRESSURE RELIEF DEVICES THAT MAY NOT VENT GAS FROM THE TANK QUICKLY ENOUGH TO REDUCE THE TANK PRESSURE SUFFICIENTLY TO AVOID RUPTURE IF THE TANK IS EXPOSED TO FIRE OR EXTREME HEAT.

title: VAN-CON, INCORPORATED: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (766 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: COACH & EQUIP SALES CORP.: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (3,000 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (182,045 affected)
summary: THE SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES MAY NOT LATCH OR MAY NOT RELEASE DUE TO THE FRACTURE OF THE RED RELEASE PUSH BUTTON.

title: HPA MONON TRAILER, INC.: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (750 affected)
summary: THE LOWER FLANGE OF THE KING PIN CAN CRACK. THIS COULD CAUSE COUPLER SEPARATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:AIR BAG (1,500 affected)
summary: THE DESIGN OF THE AIR BAG DIAGNOSTIC MONITOR CAUSES THE DRIVER'S SIDE AIR BAG TO DEPLOY WHEN THE PASSENGER DOOR IS SLAMMED WHILE THE IGNITION KEY IS TURNED TO THE START POSITION.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (40 affected)
summary: THE SUSPENSION STRUT ROD MOUNTING BOLT CAN INTERFERE WITH THE MOVEMENT OF THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT (39 affected)
summary: THE SUSPENSION SUPPORT ASSEMBLIES DO NOT MEET GENERAL MOTORS CORPORATION'S SPECIFICATION FOR WELD INTEGRITY AND THE AFFECTED WELD CAN FAIL CAUSING THE FRONT OF THE CONTROL ARM TO SEPARATE FROM THE SUSPENSION SUPPORT ASSEMBLY.

title: Fontaine Fifth Wheel Company: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY (20 affected)
summary: THERE IS A MARGINAL WELD PENETRATION BETWEEN THE BRACKET WELDMENT AND THE PLATE. THIS CAN CAUSE THE BRACKET AND PLATE TO SEPARATE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION SYSTEM (4,100 affected)
summary: THE FUEL RAIL THAT PROVIDES THE FUEL SUPPLY TO THE FUEL INJECTORS HAS AN IMPROPERLY FORMED TUBE WHICH HAS THE POTENTIAL TO FRACTURE, CAUSING FUEL TO LEAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL RETURN SPRING (20,000 affected)
summary: AS A RESULT OF INHERENT VIBRATION IN THESE ENGINES, THE THROTTLE RETURN SPRINGS CAN FRACTURE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:RESTRAINT:BELT ANCHOR AND ATTACHM (12,000 affected)
summary: THE TWO REAR INBOARD SAFETY BELT ATTACHMENT BOLTS MAY HAVE INADEQUATE THREAD ENGAGEMENT INTO THE FLOOR PAN ANCHOR NUTS.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (579 affected)
summary: THE CRUISE CONTROL CABLE MAY SEPARATE FROM THE CONDUIT END FITTING WHILE ENGAGED AND ACCELERATOR CONTROL COULD BE LOST.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:TRACKS AND ANCHORS:REAR SEAT (303 affected)
summary: THE REAR BENCH SEAT DOES NOT MEET THE LOAD REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 207, "SEATING SYSTEMS," BECAUSE THE MANUAL LATCH MECHANISM ON THE FOLDING FULL BENCH REAR SEAT WAS ATTACHED TO THE BACK FRAME LOWER CROSS TUBE WITH DOMED HEAD STEEL RIVETS INSTEAD OF THE BOLTS SPECIFIED.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (2,833 affected)
summary: PASSENGERS CLOTHING CAN UNKNOWINGLY BECOME CAUGHT IN THE HANDRAILS AT BUS DOORS WHEN EXITING THE BUS.
